title: Neurodegenerative disorders of the central nervous system
summary: Neurodegenerative disorders such as Huntington's disease, Friedreich's ataxia, or spinocerebellar degeneration with disorganization of motor function in two extremities, OR marked physical AND mental limitation.

children.criterion: Documented neurodegenerative CNS disorder (Huntington's, Friedreich's ataxia, spinocerebellar degeneration, etc.)
Motor disorganization OR marked limitation pattern
Disorganization of motor function in two extremities with extreme limitation in standing, balancing, or using upper extremities
Marked limitation in physical functioning AND in one mental functioning area
Marked limitation in one mental functioning area
